title: RESCUE: Repairing Language Model Errors to Sparse Circuits via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36813v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities that mechanistic interpretability has attributed to sparse computational circuits. However, existing circuit studies emphasize preserving functionality or explaining safety, leaving the mechanisms underlying failures across a broader range of tasks largely unexplored. Extending circuit analysis from abilities to errors, we explore the perspective that such failures may likewise arise from erroneous internal computations and that targeted tuning of the corresponding parameters can correct such errors while largely preserving other capabilities. Motivated by this insight, we introduce RESCUE (Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing), a framework that localizes error-associated circuits and surgically repairs them for performance enhancement. translated_title: RESCUE：通过强化学习对稀疏电路进行语言模型错误修复
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的通用能力，机制可解释性研究已将这些能力归因于稀疏的计算电路。然而，现有的电路研究主要强调功能保留或安全解释，对于更广泛任务中模型失败背后的机制仍未充分探索。我们将电路分析从能力扩展到错误，探讨这样一种观点：此类失败可能同样源于错误的内部计算，而对相应参数进行针对性调整可以在纠正这些错误的同时，在很大程度上保留其他能力。基于这一见解，我们提出了RESCUE（推理错误稀疏电路发现与编辑，Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing），这是一个能够定位与错误相关的电路并对其进行外科手术式修复以提升性能的框架。通用任务通常涉及多步推理和长文本生成，其中早期出现的偏差可能导致前缀……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出RESCUE框架，利用强化学习定位并外科手术式修复大语言模型中导致推理错误的稀疏计算电路，在纠正错误的同时尽量保留模型的其他能力。
en_tdlr: RESCUE is a reinforcement learning framework that localizes and surgically repairs error-associated sparse circuits in LLMs, correcting reasoning failures while largely preserving the model's other capabilities.
